Android APK for phones (arm64). To install, download the APK on the phone, open it and allow
installs from your browser or file manager when asked.

The APK is signed with a development key, so Android may warn that it comes from an unknown
developer, and a later version from the Play Store would not install over it. Data stays on the
phone; there is no account to create.

What it does is described in the [README](https://github.com/MavenTheKeen/nickel#readme).
